sourceText: Formally commit the figure generator into proofbound/experiments/recovery-runner via a small Lattice story, satisfying the committed-generator norm (every paper figure ships a runnable generator that rebuilds it from the raw records). Keep figure insertion into the paper out of scope (another session owns main.tex).
normalizedOutcome: A committed generator experiments/recovery-runner/make-fig-gate-ablation.mjs rebuilds the section 5/6 amplification figure from powered/*.jsonl (emits SVG + CSV), backed by an offline synthetic-record selfcheck wired into run-selfchecks (reports 8/8, no live LLM); the paper repo is not touched.
acceptanceClaim: Running the generator on powered/ reproduces the analyze.mjs per-arm counts (A4 2/1920, A2prime 31/1920, dedup total 9240) and writes fig-gate-ablation.svg + .csv; node run-selfchecks.mjs reports all 8 selfchecks passing offline.
